## ColorPalette

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Ui.Services.Services.ColorPalette</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Ui.Services/Services/ColorPalette.cs:17](../../../../src/Meridian.Ui.Services/Services/ColorPalette.cs#L17).

Platform-agnostic color palette defining all ARGB color values used across desktop applications. Both platform BrushRegistry classes reference this shared source of truth for color definitions and state-to-color mapping logic. These are the runtime twins of src/Meridian.Wpf/Styles/ThemeTokens.xaml. Charting, QuantScript and the ScottPlot surfaces render from here rather than from the XAML resources, so a value that moves there must move here in the same change or the two identities split — which is exactly what happened when the desktop lane was restyled and this file was not. The static palette follows the institutional light card/data surfaces in Design System 4.3.0. ThemeServiceBase changes window theme state, not these immutable values; plot backgrounds and their ink therefore remain paired in either window mode. Every core value names its XAML twin.
